title: Saro Hatzakortzian of Alien Milling on Dental Innovations
html:
In this episode of Speaking of Dentistry… The Editor’s Cut with Stan Goff, Stan Goff, Managing Editor of Dentistry Today, speaks with Saro Hatzakortzian, CEO of Alien Milling Technologies, about the company’s growth, dental milling services, and advancements in zirconia materials.

Saro discusses how Alien Milling Technologies has evolved since its founding in 2015, offering an à la carte milling model that gives dental laboratories and clinicians flexibility in choosing design, milling, and finishing services.

The conversation covers Alien Milling’s zirconia offerings, including Alien HT and Alien Multi-Layer 2.0, as well as advancements in material strength and translucency. Saro also explains how automation, digital workflows, and human quality-control checks help the company improve efficiency while maintaining consistent restoration quality.

Additional topics include modelless restorations, zirconia shade tabs, milling accuracy, and the company’s approach to making digital dental workflows more accessible for clinicians and laboratories.
